issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

uiTimezone.description:
The user's selected timezone used to convert and display timestamps in the UI.
`uiTimezone` may not be the precise geographical zone due to many to one relationships between geographic timezones and human readable label.
For example, America/Los_Angeles and America/Vancouver are both in Pacific Daylight time, {@link ReliabilityTimezoneUtils}'s getTimeZones returns unique timezones
since both are in Pacific Daylight time only one will be in the list. `uiTimezone` is used for timezone conversion purposes not to determine user local timezone.
